title: CommunicationEventSummary
description: Response shape for a communication event (list item and single-event detail). F0021. body is null when isRedacted=true. redactionReason is included only in Admin responses.

id.description: Unique identifier of the communication event.

body.description: null when isRedacted=true. Frontend renders redaction placeholder in that case.

outcome.description: null when isRedacted=true or not provided.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the interaction occurred.

authoredByUserId.description: Internal UserId of the user who logged the event. Snapshotted at creation.

authoredByDisplayName.description: Display name snapshotted at creation time. Stable even if UserProfile changes later.

lastEditedAt.description: null until the first edit. Used by frontend to show 'Edited {timestamp}' label.

isRedacted.description: true if body has been redacted by an Admin.

redactedByDisplayName.description: Snapshotted display name of the Admin who performed the redaction. null if not redacted.

redactionReason.description: Included only in Admin role responses. null for non-Admin users and when not redacted.

followUpTaskId.description: ID of the linked TaskItem, if a follow-up task was created.

followUpTaskTitle.description: Denormalized task title for display on the communication card.

followUpTaskStatus.description: Denormalized task status (e.g. 'Open', 'Done'). Used to render completed/muted style on card.
